                [0, 0, 0, 0, 2],
                [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
                [0, 0, 3, 2, 1],
                [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
                [0, 1, 0, 2, 3],
            ],
            dtype=torch.long,
            device=device,
        )

            sequences > 0, (sequences - 1).remainder(model.itemnum) + 1, sequences
        )

            features[sequences == 0],

                expected_scores,
